items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Well, I did the 'Lucy Show'. >> [(prose)] the "Bill Cosby Show," "This is Your Life," "Nancy Wilson Show," to name a few. You know. [(note)] There are 25 studio musicians.

ctx.x: Well, let's see, the last one I did with him was with Chad Everett, 'The First was to Fight', another one was Banning, and something. You know, Bobby's very active in the acting role, you know, acting field. That's another one of his many talents. So I've done quite a few with him, and as you know I've done quite a few TV shows here. I've got to make some money. Well, I did the 'Lucy Show'.
